raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated Richard N. Palmer (the Connecticut Supreme Court justice) with a different person, Richard Palmer (engineer), and treated the engineer’s “Nationality: British” as applicable to Richard N. Palmer. This source mix-up led to the incorrect inference that Palmer was British, contradicting credible sources indicating he is American.
